svg.title: Five Calls, Three at a Time
svg.desc: A timeline of five model calls with at most three in flight, where a rate-limited call retries after a growing delay and a malformed request is not retried.
svg.text: Five Calls, Three at a Time
Penrose Games: a 429 waits and retries; a 400 never gets better by asking again.
THE LIMIT AND THE RETRY, IN CODE
